shortDescription: module for create, delete and update of database server vms

options.name: automated_patching
options.description: configure automated patching using maintenance windows to be only used while creation

options.name: cluster
options.description: ndb cluster where the vm will be hosted required for create

options.name: compute_profile
options.description: required for create compute profile details

options.name: database_type
options.description: database engine type

options.name: delete_from_cluster
options.description: set this during c(state) = absent to delete vm from source cluster

options.name: delete_vgs
options.description: set this during c(state) = absent to delete volume groups from source cluster

options.name: delete_vm_snapshots
options.description: set this during c(state) = absent to delete vm's snapshot from source cluster

options.name: desc
options.description: description of vm allowed for update

options.name: name
options.description: name of database server vm update allowed

options.name: network_profile
options.description: network profile details required for create

options.name: nutanix_debug
options.description: Enable detailed debug logging for all API calls made by this module. When enabled, logs will include HTTP method, URL, headers, request body, response body, status code, and elapsed time. Authorization headers and sensitive information are automatically redacted. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_host
options.description: ndb era server IP address C(nutanix_host). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_HOST), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_log_file
options.description: The file to write the logs to. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_password
options.description: ndb era server password C(nutanix_password). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_PASSWORD), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_username
options.description: ndb era server username C(nutanix_username). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_USERNAME), environment variable is used.

options.name: password
options.description: password of vm

options.name: pub_ssh_key
options.description: give access using user's public ssh key

options.name: reset_desc_in_ntnx_cluster
options.description: set this to reset description of vm to name in ndb in cluster as well

options.name: reset_name_in_ntnx_cluster
options.description: set this to reset name of vm to name in ndb in cluster as well

options.name: soft_remove
options.description: set this during c(state) = absent to perform soft remove of database server vm

options.name: software_profile
options.description: use software profile as source for creating vm required for create either name or uuid is mandatory

options.name: state
options.description: when C(state)=present and uuid given, it will update db server vm when C(state)=present and uuid not given, it will create new db server vm when C(state)=absent, by default it will perform unregistration process unless supported arguments are given

options.name: tags
options.description: dict of tag name as key and tag value as value update allowed during update, given input will override existing tags

options.name: time_machine
options.description: use time machine as source for creating vm either name or uuid is mandatory

options.name: time_zone
options.description: timezone of vm

options.name: timeout
options.description: timeout for polling of operation, after which module will error out

options.name: update_credentials
options.description: update credentials of vm in ndb this update should be done post vm credentials update in source cluster

options.name: uuid
options.description: uuid of database server vm for updating or deleting vm will be used to update if C(state) is C(present) and to delete if C(state) is C(absent)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Set value to C(False) to skip validation for self signed certificates This is not recommended for production setup C(validate_certs). If not set then the value of the C(VALIDATE_CERTS), environment variable is used.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the  CRUD operation to complete.
